comments.body: Those two aren't really good results if you compare it to what is available for dedicated pixel art image generators (i.e. Retro Diffusion) - they create way better pixel art, down to almost 16x16.

replies.author: No-Marionberry-772
replies.body:
absolutely. While Opus 4.6 has some impressive spatial understanding, it wont beat out a dedicated model. Probably never will?


I have a simple test that does some 3d modeling using Unity Primitives with a simple line based specification, basically;
name, parent, type, position, scale, rotation.


I got some impressive results, considering its a language model, and it was constrained to cubes, spheres, planes and capsules.
completely unusable results realistically, but impressive for a language model.
